tools.name: get_brick_mosaic_options
tools.description: List the available BrickYourFace mosaic sizes (baseplates), prices and shipping, and how ordering works. Call this before creating a preview if the person asks about sizes or price.

tools.name: create_brick_mosaic_preview
tools.description: Turn a photo into a BrickYourFace brick mosaic. Returns a watermarked preview image of what the finished mosaic will look like, its size and price, and a private link where the person can review it and buy the kit. Provide the photo as image_url (a public https link to the image file) or image_base6
